gui.description: Qt6 Widgets MIDAS verification GUI (apps/verification-gui) plus its Qt-independent verification/ library (ExcelReferenceReader, via xlnt for .xlsx); not built by default, requested only via -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=gui so the routine Ubuntu CI matrix in ci.yml never builds Qt6/xlnt from source. qtbase is requested with default-features:false + an explicit minimal {gui,widgets,network} list ('core' is implicit, cannot be named) -- apps/verification-gui never uses QtNetwork classes directly, but 'network' is actually a QtCore-level feature (QT_FEATURE_network) gating the socket-notifier infrastructure QProcess itself depends on internally, confirmed necessary after dropping it broke QProcess::ExitStatus entirely (GUI-7, 2026-10-21; Bitcoin Core's own minimal qtbase feature list independently confirms including 'network' for exactly this kind of build). Still excludes qtbase's heavier default-features that are genuinely unused here (dbus, sql-psql, sql-sqlite, testlib, icu, harfbuzz, brotli, opengl, openssl, async-io, sessionmanager, dnslookup, zstd), which is what was exhausting a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner's disk building them from source. windeployqt is requested only on Windows (platform-filtered), since it is a Windows-only deployment tool with no effect on Linux.
